text_block_list.text: It's time for the Hopeful Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the audience only talks about two
particular
Umamusume who have
continued to shine after
their debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The buzz is all about Уиннинг Тикит and
Biwa
Hayahide, and which of them will
win the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин steps up to the racecourse
to show
the world her true abilities and
make her presence
known.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
